summary: V5.3 Director's Console + One-Shot Scaffold validated end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_iter24_v53.py PASS — including the LIVE Claude Sonnet scaffold-oneshot preview call (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is set in this env). Director GET returns system_id=cypher + npc_pool aggregated from Genesis seed_npcs[] + Epic Campaign nemesis/villains + Codex npc nodes; players hit 403; PUT round-trips encounters/npcs with id-stamping + current_location + current_phase_ref. CR-analyse on Cypher tier-1 PC vs L4 villain + 3xL2 minions returned rating='Punishing' with remove_npc + feat suggestions; empty NPC array → 'Pushover'; empty party → 'Unknown'. Scaffold preview returns committed=false + preview block with summary/title_suggestion/etc. Frontend: GM logged in via UI, /app/campaigns/{cid}/director rendered director-console + director-npc-pool + director-encounter-editor + cr-panel; default cr-panel showed 'Unknown · No party seated.'; clicking a pool-pick-* button bumped 'NPCs: 1 NPCs'; toggling director-party-{charId} seated the PC and the cr-panel updated to 'Fair · Effective level 1.5 (encounter 3.0 + overflow 0.0 − party step-down 1.5)' with avg-Tier 1.0 + ~1.5 step-downs, AND populated the SUGGESTIONS list (one-shot Cypher, uneven ground reposition). On the campaign Atelier tab, the new scaffold-panel renders with 'ONE-SHOT SCAFFOLD · 60-SECOND CAMPAIGN DEPLOY' header, scaffold-preview-btn ('Preview a one-shot'), and a wired file input — exactly as spec'd.
critical_code_review_comments: core/cr_engine.py is well-structured: separate analyse_dnd / analyse_cypher / analyse_besm with a dispatcher that auto-routes anime-5e to D&D when CR is set, BESM otherwise. DMG p.82 thresholds + group multipliers match the canonical table. Cypher engine uses tier×1.5 step-down heuristic which produced a believable 'Punishing' for the tier-1 vs L4+3xL2 stress test. Suggestion icons (swords/shield/mountain/etc.) align with the spec.

routes/director.py correctly enforces GM/admin-only on all three routes (verified live — player got 403). _gather_npc_pool de-duplicates across genesis/epic/codex via a (source:name) seen-set — good defence against double-listing the nemesis as both Epic + Codex. _stamp_ids() stamps both encounter ids and per-encounter npc ids on PUT, which round-tripped cleanly.

routes/ingest.py POST /campaigns/{cid}/scaffold-oneshot correctly returns 422 on missing multipart file (validated), processes a real markdown file through Claude Sonnet on commit=false, and returns the documented {committed:false, preview:{...}} envelope. The route signature + Pydantic shape are sound.

DirectorConsole.jsx debounces cr-analyse calls and is reactive to party-seat / pool-pick / npc-edit changes — confirmed live (cr-panel updated within ~2s of each interaction). All required testids (director-console, director-npc-pool, director-encounter-editor, cr-panel, pool-pick-*, director-party-{charId}) are present and wired.

IngestPanel.jsx scaffold-panel renders unconditionally on the AtelierTab and exposes both scaffold-preview-btn and the file <input type='file'> — spec-compliant. Did NOT live-fire a UI scaffold preview because the spec only required the button + file input to exist (and the backend live-fire is already covered).
